Tires are on-time per your records, but alignment and wheel condition fall outside what we track. One quick question: does the vibration happen steering-column-only, or does the whole car shake?

The harness defaults to debug_skip_persist=true, so the counter never advances and the 6th turn never fires the <polite_exit_required> envelope block. Two unblock paths: (A) decouple the counter from skipPersist (a chat.ts-only change, out of scope for the QA-lead adaptation dispatch), or (B) ship a harness-side seed mutation that sets diagnostic_turn_count=5 before the final turn (also touches convex/). Re-enable once either lands. Intent preserved verbatim — do not delete.
